meta.title: MCP Manager
meta.description: Manage the MCP servers you have added — enable, configure, or add new tool capabilities.

en.commandHint: For example npx, uvx, or an absolute executable path.
en.cwdHint: Optional; inherits the current directory when empty.
en.description: Manage the MCP servers you have added — enable, configure, or add new tool capabilities.
en.editJsonHint: Edit this server’s JSON configuration directly. Renaming it here renames the row, keeping its id and its enabled/disabled state; switch back to the form to review it.
en.emptyHint: Use “Add” to paste an MCP configuration from any tool (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, OpenCode, …).
en.formatsFooter: Different key names are understood as-is — no rewriting needed. JSON comments and trailing commas are fine too.
en.formatsSummary: Accepts MCP configuration pasted from these tools (expand to see the container key)
en.manualHint: Paste an MCP configuration from any of these tools as-is — no rewriting: Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, OpenCode, Continue, Pi, Cherry Studio, Windsurf, Qoder, CodeBuddy, TRAE, ZCode and DeepSeek Harness (TOML and JSON-with-comments included).
en.manualWarn: Verify the source and assess the risk before configuring.
en.name: Server name
en.nameHint: Letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only, 1–32 characters. Prefixes tools as mcp__<name>__.
en.noTools: No tools yet (the server may be disconnected, or exposes none).
en.notWritable: The configuration file is not writable, so changes cannot be saved: {path}
en.removeConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This removes the server from the configuration file.
en.title: MCP Servers
